hero.eyebrow: Steam Early Access · Boomer Shooter · Roguelite
hero.subtitle: Enter the alien labyrinth where every corridor could be your last. Navigate deadly mazes, battle extraterrestrial threats, and race against time to escape. In LABYRAINTH, survival is an art form.
game.heading: The Ultimate Maze Experience
game.intro: LABYRAINTH is a heart-pounding sci-fi FPS that challenges you to navigate through procedurally generated alien labyrinths. Every playthrough is unique, every corner holds danger, and every second counts.
game.f1.title: Combat System
game.f1.body: Engage in intense firefights with alien creatures using an arsenal of upgradeable weapons. Each weapon has unique properties and upgrade paths.
game.f1.alt: LABYRAINTH combat gameplay: an upgradeable weapon on the loadout bench in a neon-lit alien bay
game.f2.title: Time-Based Survival
game.f2.body: Race against the clock as the labyrinth changes around you. Environmental hazards increase as time runs out.
game.f2.alt: LABYRAINTH time pressure: the countdown HUD as the labyrinth reconfigures around the player
game.f3.title: Power Abilities
game.f3.body: Unlock and activate special powers to gain tactical advantages. From temporary invisibility to energy shields.
game.f3.alt: LABYRAINTH power abilities: a special power orb being activated in a hexagonal corridor
game.f4.title: Resource Management
game.f4.body: Collect rare materials to upgrade your equipment. Strategic resource allocation is key to survival.
game.f4.alt: LABYRAINTH resource management: rare crafting materials collected from a maze cache
game.f5.title: Alien World
game.f5.body: Explore beautifully crafted alien environments with dynamic lighting and atmospheric effects.
game.f5.alt: LABYRAINTH alien world: a vast extraterrestrial vista with dynamic lighting and atmospheric haze
game.f6.title: Procedural Generation
game.f6.body: No two runs are the same. Experience infinite replayability with randomly generated maze layouts.
game.f6.alt: LABYRAINTH procedural generation: a freshly generated maze layout seen from the map overlay

team.heading: The Architects of the Maze
team.sub: Meet the dedicated team behind LABYRAINTH's immersive alien world
team.m1.bio: Pietro is the leader of G.U.F.O. games and the original creator of LABYRAINTH. He designed and worked on every parts of the game.
team.m2.bio: Giorgio is the creator of LABYRAINTH and main partner of G.U.F.O. Games. He is the main working force of LABYRAINTH.
team.m3.bio: Without Marta LABYRAINTH would not be as beautiful as it is. She is also the original member of G.U.F.O. games.
team.m4.bio: All the traps, power ups, orbs and many VFX effects you see in the game are thanks to Giulio.
team.m5.bio: Lorenzo made sure many UIs are behaving correctly, also he made the game speak 16 languages.
team.m6.bio: Enemies move and think thanks to Diego. He also designed the labyrinth parsing algorithms with Pietro.
team.m7.bio: Davide optimized the game to run well on both Windows and MacOs computers, so you can run the game on your potato pc.
team.m8.bio: Claudio worked behind the curtains to create many software tools for the game to make it work flawlessly.
team.m9.bio: Francesco has only recently joined the team and is already adding sparks to the game.
team.m10.bio: Davide was one of the first to join the team and has been working on the Backend Game Server ever since.
team.m11.bio: If you see yourself in the Leaderboards, and see your progress in online modes, then that is thanks to Matteo.
team.m12.bio: Andrea makes sure the Game Server is always up and running making sure you can play the online game modes.
team.m13.bio: Lorenzo designed the AWS game server to make sure you can play the game with no halts and waiting time.
team.m14.bio: If you found this game is probably thanks to Emiliano, and his great work in making sure many people know about LABYRAINTH.

feedback.warning.p2: All feedback will be reviewed by our development team, and we will consider it for future updates and improvements.
